facts.fact: The National Data Centre in Blantyre, built by Huawei and run with the Ministry of Information and ESCOM, was launched in July 2022 and by February 2024 hosted 78 virtual machines, each for one client, with ESCOM reporting demand from both government bodies and the private sector.

systems.owner: Government of Malawi; operated with Ministry of Information and ESCOM
